key_insight: MatScope finds that language models handle supplied-input calculations and many physical explanations well but struggle with fine-grained material-state comparisons and quantitatively supported decisions.
engineering_relevance: Reliable AI-assisted materials discovery requires condition-aware comparisons and evidence updates that do not undermine previously accurate predictions.
method: M1: Test unaided, condition-specific reasoning on 200 tasks across ten research functions using aluminium and high-entropy alloys.
M2: Evaluate agent-assisted transfer of related knowledge to unresolved materials questions.
MatEvoBench-20: Assess initial forecasts across scientific dependency chains and revisions as observations accumulate.
evidence_signal: Across eleven model deployments, related literature improved selected estimates, while progressive observations calibrated some downstream responses but destabilized some earlier accurate predictions.
watch_item: Condition and baseline mismatches can limit knowledge transfer, so literature-assisted estimates need validation against the specific material state.
paper_title: Benchmarking language models and agents for scientific reasoning in evolving materials laboratories
